rationale: Optimized dispatch to minimize cost by maximizing inverter active power usage (free energy) and setting diesel reactive power to its preferred value (4.0 Mvar) to avoid penalty. Diesel provides 14 MW (34 MW load - 20 MW inverter max), inverter provides 20 MW and 8 Mvar reactive. Voltage calculated as 0.965 + 0.0025 * 12 = 0.995 pu. Total cost = 14 * 76 + 0 = 1064 $/h.
